i18n.inspect.summary.animgraph: XML animation graph/blend tree describing bones, variables, states and transitions; it contains no mesh and needs a model plus an animation player to display motion.
i18n.inspect.summary.animation: XML animation entry that references a sibling .rawanimation and adds properties/events; playback needs a skeleton and model renderer.
i18n.inspect.summary.animconfig: XML animation list mapping the character's available animation names to files.
i18n.inspect.summary.trackgroup: XML timeline that triggers particles, audio or motion events over time, usually paired with a character .animation.
i18n.inspect.summary.lod: Text or XML LOD/material/render parameters; not a standalone geometric model.
i18n.inspect.summary.spr: Text atlas manifest with texture filenames, regions and frame info for cropping the matching PNG/KTA.
i18n.inspect.summary.gim: Binary object configuration that usually references skeletons, submeshes, materials and attach points/effects; it is not an image and cannot be drawn alone.
i18n.inspect.summary.mtg: Binary material parameters with material slots, texture references and shader technique names; a material renderer is required to display it.
i18n.inspect.summary.sfx: Binary effect/keyframe parameters that usually reference particle materials and textures; an effect player is required to display them.
i18n.inspect.summary.efx: Binary particle system with particle resources, shaders and texture references; a particle renderer is required to display it.
i18n.inspect.summary.gmp: Binary map/scene data, not a standalone model; visualization needs terrain, object and material formats.
i18n.inspect.summary.xn: Protected script/bytecode container, not a visual resource; you can only inspect strings, hex or download it.
i18n.inspect.summary.qm: Compiled Qt Linguist translation containing UI strings; not a game visual resource.
i18n.inspect.summary.csb: Cocos Studio binary UI layout with a node tree, images and animation references; rendering needs the Cocos UI runtime.
i18n.inspect.summary.rawanimation: Binary skeletal track keyframes referencing a .skeleton; playback needs skinning and an animation player.
i18n.inspect.summary.skeleton: Binary joint hierarchy and bind matrices; a skinned mesh renderer is required to display it.
i18n.inspect.summary.mesh: Binary mesh with vertices, faces and bone weights; this client's vertex data has packed/quantized variants, so generic 3D preview is not wired up yet.
i18n.inspect.summary.unknown: Unrecognized resource format; you can inspect readable strings and hex.
